capabilities: Increment major, minor, or patch version components
Configure versions per note in a fenced code block
Render increment buttons in Reading View
Expose a command per version component
Validate and atomically update the frontmatter property
extras: Buttons render only in Reading View, not Live Preview or Source mode; the NOTICE file requires attribution in redistributions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to increment a version number stored in a note's frontmatter properties.
summary: Plugin that increments a note's version property (major, minor, patch) using Reading View buttons or commands, configured per note.
